name: Binance
notes: 全球交易量第一大 CEX。现任 CEO 为 Richard Teng（2023年11月接替辞职的创始人 CZ）；联合创始人为何一（Yi He，兼任 Binance Labs 负责人及 CMO）；创始人/前 CEO 为赵长鹏（Changpeng Zhao / CZ）。冒充风险极高：大量假冒上币经理（Listing Agents）、虚假空投钓鱼链接及假客服 Telegram 群，必须使用官方 Verify 工具核实。

name: OKX
org: OKX Technology Company Limited / Aux Cayes FinTech Co. Ltd.
notes: 原名 OKEx，于 2022 年 1 月正式更名为 OKX。创始人兼现任 CEO 为徐明星（Star Xu / Mingxing Xu，早年创办 Okcoin）；CMO 为 Haider Rafique；前总裁方宏（Hong Fang）已离任转任 BitGo。主打 Web3 钱包及二层网络 X Layer。冒充风险高：常见假冒 OKX 钱包升级钓鱼网站、假 Telegram 空投群及伪造上币 BD。

name: Bitget
notes: 全球排名前列的衍生品与跟单交易平台。现任 CEO 为 Gracy Chen（@GracyBitget，2022年任董事总经理，2024年5月升任 CEO）；前任 CEO 为 Sandra Lou。旗下拥有 Bitget Wallet（原 BitKeep）。冒充风险高：常见假冒带单老师、虚假跟单策略分成诈骗群以及伪造 OTC 商家。

name: Bybit
notes: 全球顶尖衍生品与现货交易所，总部设立于阿联酋迪拜。联合创始人兼现任 CEO 为周必胜（Ben Zhou，自 2018 年创立以来持续担任 CEO）；联合创始人/核心高管包括 Latica Chou 等。深度支持 Mantle 生态（MNT）。冒充风险高：虚假 VIP 客服私聊、虚假 Telegram P2P 担保群及仿冒钓鱼域名。

name: Coinbase

accounts.telegram: None (Coinbase explicitly operates NO official Telegram support channels)

notes: 美国第一大合规上市加密交易所，美国大部分现货 BTC/ETH ETF 的核心托管行。联合创始人兼现任 CEO 为 Brian Armstrong；总裁兼 COO 为 Emilie Choi；CFO 为 Alesia Haas；首席法务官为 Paul Grewal；联合创始人兼董事为 Fred Ehrsam（前总裁，Paradigm 创始人）。上币公告由 @CoinbaseAssets 官方发布。重要安全提示：Coinbase 官方明确声明不提供任何 Telegram 或 WhatsApp 官方支持，任何电报群内的 Coinbase 客服皆为钓鱼骗局。

name: Kraken

accounts.telegram: None (Kraken operates NO official Telegram customer support channels)

notes: 历史悠久的欧美合规主力交易所（2011年创立）。现行管理层采取联合 CEO（Co-CEO）架构：Dave Ripley（2023年4月自 Jesse Powell 手中接任 CEO，2024年10月转为 Co-CEO）与 Arjun Sethi（Tribe Capital 联合创始人，2024年10月起被任命为 Co-CEO）；创始人 Jesse Powell 现任董事会主席。正筹备推出 Ink L2 网络。重要提示：Kraken 官方声明绝不使用 Telegram 或 WhatsApp 提供客户服务，需警惕仿冒客服及假冒上币团队。

name: Gate.io
notes: 原名比特儿（Bter.com，创办于2013年），2017年监管整顿后全面重塑更名为 Gate.io（亦启用 gate.com）。创始人兼现任 CEO 为韩林博士（Dr. Lin Han）。以长尾山寨币种及 Startup 申购发行闻名。冒充风险高：常见假冒 Startup 免费空投链接、伪造客服验证页面与假冒官方上币上所收费中介。

name: MEXC
notes: 前身为 MXC（抹茶），2021年品牌升级为 MEXC Global。现任 CEO 为 Vugar Usi Zade（曾任 COO，后晋升为 CEO；曾有 Bitget 高管经历）；前早期高管 John Chen 已于 2022 年离职，官方在 2023 年底曾公开澄清官方不存在以 CEO 个人名义运营的推特账号。主打极速上线 Meme 币、微市值代币及现货零费率。冒充风险极高：大量假冒上币中介通过电报私信索要 listing fee，常见虚假带单跟单社群。

name: HTX
org: HTX / Huobi Global (backed by About Capital Management)
notes: 前身为火币（Huobi，2013年由李林创办）。2022年10月百域资本（About Capital）收购李林所持多数股权，孙宇晨（Justin Sun）入驻并担任全球顾问委员会成员及实际代言人；2023年9月十周年之际正式改名为 HTX（H 代表 Huobi，T 代表 TRON，X 代表 Exchange）。品牌更名历史多，存在大量冒充 Huobi/HTX 历史老域名、假冒孙宇晨助理及假冒 HTX DAO 空投的钓鱼欺诈风险。

name: KuCoin
org: Mek Global Limited / PhoenixFin Pte. Ltd.
notes: 被称为'全民的交易所'（The People's Exchange）。现任 CEO 为 BC Wong（此前曾任首席合规/法务负责人，为强化全球合规接任 CEO）；联合创始人兼前 CEO 为吕康（Johnny Lyu，2020至2024年间担任 CEO）；早期创始人为 Michael Gan（甘纯）及 Eric Don。冒充风险高：常见伪造上币团队、假冒 KuCoin Cert 验真钓鱼页面以及仿冒 P2P 仲裁客服。

name: Backpack
org: Trek Labs Ltd FZE / Coral Community Inc.
notes: 受迪拜 VARA 监管合规许可的加密交易所。由 Solana 核心开发团队 Coral 及 Mad Lads 社区孵化。创始人兼 CEO 为 Armani Ferrante（@armaniferrante，Anchor 框架创作者）；联合创始人为 Tristan Yver（@sorryyver）；前联合创始人/法务 Can Sun（前 FTX 总法律顾问）早期参与设立 Trek Labs 后已退出。冒充风险高：网络上存在大量针对 Mad Lads 社区及 Backpack 空投资格的假冒钱包插件及授权钓鱼（Wallet Drainer）网站。

name: Hyperliquid

accounts.telegram: None (Hyperliquid operates strictly via Discord and X; no official Telegram trading chat)
accounts.youtube: None (content shared on X and community podcasts)

notes: 链上订单薄永续合约 DEX 龙头，拥有独立高性能 L1 共识引擎（HyperBFT）与原生 EVM。团队完全自融无 VC 股权投资。核心创始人兼贡献者为 Jeff Yan（@chameleon_jeff，哈佛数学与计算机双学位、前 HRT 量化交易员）与 iliensinc。基金会 X 账号为 @HyperFND。重要安全提示：Hyperliquid 官方未开设任何官方 Telegram 交流或客服群，主要交流在 Discord（discord.gg/hyperliquid）；需高度警惕伪造 HYPE 空投领取代币的恶意钓鱼网站与假 Telegram 群。

name: Upbit

accounts.telegram: None (Upbit explicitly does NOT operate official Telegram chatrooms or trading signal channels)

notes: 韩国第一大合规法币加密交易所（占据韩国市场逾 70% 份额），运营母公司为 Dunamu Inc.。现任 CEO 为吴庆锡（Oh Kyung-suk，2025年6月接替因健康原因提前卸任的李锡佑 Lee Sirgoo）；创始人兼董事会主席为宋致亨（Song Chi-hyung）；前任 CEO 李锡佑曾于 2017 至 2025 年长期执掌 Dunamu。Upbit 上币公告对全球山寨币行情具备极强的即时拉盘效应（'Upbit 上币效应'）。重要提示：Upbit 严格遵守韩国监管，官方绝不在 Telegram 或 KakaoTalk 开设任何带单荐股群，需严防声称有'内部上币老鼠仓'的电报杀猪盘。

name: Bithumb

accounts.telegram: None (Bithumb operates NO official Telegram trading or customer support channels)

notes: 韩国第二大加密货币交易所，Upbit 的主要本土竞争对手。现任 CEO 为李载元（Lee Jae-won，2022年就任并获连任；2026年8月卸任母公司 Bithumb Holdings 代表理事一职以全力专注 Bithumb 交易所业务，控股公司 CEO 由金基范接任以推动 IPO）；早期创始人及控股股东为前理事会议长李政勋（Lee Jung-hoon）。常发起免手续费活动争夺交易量。冒充风险：韩国本地常见伪造 Bithumb 验证码短信（Smishing）以及 KakaoTalk/Telegram 虚假理财指导骗局。

name: Robinhood Crypto
org: Robinhood Crypto, LLC / Robinhood Markets, Inc. (Nasdaq: HOOD)

accounts.telegram: None (Robinhood strictly maintains NO Telegram groups or customer support channels)

notes: 美股互联网券商巨头 Robinhood（Nasdaq: HOOD）旗下专属加密资产实体。业务负责人（SVP & General Manager of Crypto）为 Johann Kerbrat（@JohannKerbrat）；母公司 Robinhood Markets 联合创始人兼 CEO 为 Vlad Tenev；联合创始人 Baiju Bhatt 已于 2024 年卸任高管职务。已通过收购老牌交易所 Bitstamp 加速全球化及机构业务布局。重要安全提示：Robinhood 绝不通过 Telegram、WhatsApp 等社交通讯软件提供客服服务，必须警惕假冒投资理财、追讨资金与虚假 Robinhood 空投骗局。

name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)
current_role: Primary US federal securities regulatory agency supervising securities markets, crypto asset securities enforcement, and exchange-traded product (ETP) registrations
notes: Extreme market sensitivity. Historic January 2024 SIM-swap breach of official @SECGov handle led to premature fake ETF approval tweet. High risk of copycat/impersonator accounts circulating fake enforcement or approval notices.

name: Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC)
current_role: Primary US federal derivatives regulator exercising regulatory oversight over digital asset commodities, futures, swaps, and fraud/manipulation enforcement
notes: Dedicated enforcement RSS: https://www.cftc.gov/RSS/RSSENF/rssenf.xml. Enforces Commodity Exchange Act against unregistered derivatives and offshore platforms (e.g., Binance, BitMEX, KuCoin). Active jurisdictional disputes with SEC regarding digital asset commodity classification.

name: U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ)
current_role: Federal law enforcement agency prosecuting federal criminal offenses, money laundering, sanctions evasion, and darknet illicit finance via the National Cryptocurrency Enforcement Team (NCET)
notes: Enforcement actions handled by NCET, Criminal Division, and key US Attorney Offices (SDNY, EDNY). Press releases frequently announce major criminal indictments, multi-billion-dollar forfeitures, and international takedowns.

name: Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)
current_role: US Department of the Treasury agency administering economic and trade sanctions, publishing SDN designations targeting malicious crypto addresses, mixers, and facilitating services
notes: NOTE: OFAC officially retired its standalone RSS feed on January 31, 2025; updates are published directly to ofac.treasury.gov/recent-actions and via GovDelivery email service. Vital for real-time on-chain screening of blacklisted wallet addresses.

name: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)
current_role: UK financial conduct and prudential regulator supervising cryptoasset AML/CFT registration, financial promotions regime, and consumer risk warnings
notes: Strict financial promotion regime (FG24/1) imposes criminal liability for unauthorized crypto marketing to UK residents. Maintains an active Warning List of unauthorized crypto firms.

name: Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS)
current_role: Singapore central bank and integrated financial supervisor licensing Digital Payment Token (DPT) service providers under the Payment Services Act and regulating asset tokenization / stablecoins
notes: MAS does not provide an active public RSS feed; announcements are published directly on mas.gov.sg/news/media-releases and distributed via email notifications. Leads institutional tokenization initiatives via Project Guardian.

name: Securities and Futures Commission (SFC Hong Kong)
current_role: Hong Kong statutory securities regulator administering the Virtual Asset Trading Platform (VATP) licensing regime under AMLO, authorizing spot crypto ETFs, and issuing investor alerts
notes: Traditional Chinese RSS available at https://www.sfc.hk/TC/RSS-Feeds. SFC does not maintain an official X (Twitter) account; primary social channels are LinkedIn, YouTube, Facebook, WeChat, and Xiaohongshu (Rednote). Maintains Alert List of suspicious virtual asset trading platforms.

name: European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA)
current_role: European Union financial markets authority overseeing implementation of the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation, drafting technical standards, and maintaining the central CASP register
notes: Coordinating body for MiCA across all 27 EU member state National Competent Authorities (NCAs). Replaced RSS with modern categorized Newsroom portal and newsletter service.

name: Federal Financial Supervisory Authority (BaFin)
current_role: German federal integrated financial supervisor administering crypto custody business licensing under the German Banking Act (KWG) and supervising German MiCA implementation
notes: CRITICAL IMPERSONATION ALERT: BaFin does NOT operate an official X (Twitter) account and has issued formal consumer alerts against fraudulent accounts falsely using its name on Twitter. Supervision RSS: https://www.bafin.de/DE/service/rss/_function/RSS_Aufsicht.xml?nn=150166.

name: Financial Services Agency of Japan (JFSA / 金融庁)
current_role: Japanese government agency supervising Crypto-Asset Exchange Service Providers (CAESP) under the Payment Services Act and stablecoin issuance under the revised Electronic Payment Instruments regime
notes: Japanese language RSS: https://www.fsa.go.jp/fsaNewsList_rss2.xml. Enforces strict cold wallet and segregated custody requirements that protected users during FTX Japan. Issues formal warning letters to unregistered overseas exchanges soliciting Japanese residents.

name: Capital Markets Board of Turkey (SPK / Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu)
current_role: Turkish capital markets regulator vested with comprehensive licensing, operational, and custody oversight over Crypto Asset Service Providers (KVHS) under Law No. 7518
notes: Milestone regulatory expansion: In July 2024, Turkey enacted Law No. 7518 amending Capital Markets Law No. 6362, bringing all crypto asset service providers under direct SPK licensing. Publishes the official 'Faaliyette Bulunanlar Listesi' (List of operating platforms undergoing licensing).

name: Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK Indonesia)
current_role: Indonesian financial services authority possessing primary statutory authority over digital financial assets and crypto asset trading following the completion of supervisory transfer from Bappebti
notes: MAJOR REGULATORY HANDOVER: Pursuant to the P2SK Law (Law No. 4/2023) and PP No. 49/2024, supervisory authority over crypto assets formally transferred from Bappebti to OJK on January 10, 2025. Regulated under POJK No. 27/2024 and amended under POJK No. 23/2025.

name: Badan Pengawas Perdagangan Berjangka Komoditi (Bappebti Indonesia)
current_role: Indonesian Commodity Futures Trading Regulatory Agency under Ministry of Trade; established initial regulatory foundation and national crypto bourse (CFX) prior to Jan 2025 OJK handover
notes: Historically regulated Indonesian crypto assets as tradeable commodities from 2018 through January 10, 2025. Established national crypto exchange CFX (PT Bursa Komoditi Nusantara). Successfully transitioned regulatory jurisdiction to OJK in January 2025.

name: Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM Brazil)
current_role: Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission regulating crypto asset securities, tokenized assets (Parecer de Orientação 40), and spot crypto ETFs listed on B3
notes: Legislation RSS: https://conteudo.cvm.gov.br/feed/legislacao.xml. Division of authority: CVM regulates crypto securities, tokenized investment vehicles, and spot crypto ETFs (including early global approvals for Solana, Bitcoin, and Ethereum ETFs), while Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) regulates VASPs and payment tokens under Law 14.478/2022.

name: Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA Dubai)
current_role: World's first dedicated independent virtual assets regulator, governing VASP licensing, market conduct, and AML compliance across the Emirate of Dubai (excluding DIFC)
notes: Established under Dubai Law No. 4 of 2022. Enforces Virtual Assets and Related Activities Regulations 2023 covering advisory, broker-dealer, custody, exchange, lending, and transfer/settlement services. Issues high-visibility enforcement fines and cease orders against unlicensed foreign operators targeting UAE residents.

name: BlackRock
current_role: World's largest asset manager ($11T+ AUM); issuer of iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT), iShares Ethereum Trust (ETHA), and tokenized liquidity fund BUIDL
notes: IBIT became the fastest ETF to reach $10B and $30B AUM in market history. BUIDL tokenized fund operates on Ethereum, Aptos, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Optimism, and Polygon. Key leadership: Larry Fink (Chairman & CEO), Robert Mitchnick (Head of Digital Assets).

name: Fidelity Investments (Fidelity Digital Assets)
current_role: Major multinational financial services corporation; issuer of Fidelity Wise Origin Bitcoin Fund (FBTC) and Fidelity Ethereum Fund (FETH); self-custody provider for digital assets
notes: Distinct from competitors, Fidelity custody its own underlying ETF crypto collateral in-house via state-chartered Fidelity Digital Asset Services, LLC, rather than relying on third-party custodians.

name: Bitwise Asset Management
current_role: Specialist crypto asset management firm; issuer of Bitwise Bitcoin ETF (BITB), Bitwise Ethereum ETF (ETHW), crypto index funds, and European crypto ETCs
notes: First US spot Bitcoin ETF sponsor to publish its wallet addresses publicly on-chain. Key leadership: Hunter Horsley (CEO, @HunterHorsley), Matt Hougan (CIO, @Matt_Hougan). Expanded European presence through acquisition of London-based ETC Group.

name: 21Shares
current_role: Pioneering crypto ETP issuer; co-sponsor of ARK 21Shares Bitcoin ETF (ARKB) and Ethereum ETF (CETH) in the US; market leader in European physical crypto ETPs
notes: Key leadership: Hany Rashwan (Co-Founder), Ophelia Snyder (Co-Founder & President). Operates proprietary Onyx technology platform for issuance. Longstanding partnership with Cathie Wood's ARK Investment Management.

name: VanEck
current_role: Global asset management firm; issuer of VanEck Bitcoin Trust (HODL) and VanEck Ethereum ETF (ETHV); first institutional applicant for US spot Solana and Avalanche ETFs
notes: Key leadership: Jan van Eck (CEO, @janvaneck3), Matthew Sigel (Head of Digital Assets Research, @matthew_sigel). Consistently acts as first-mover in regulatory filings for new crypto underlying assets (e.g., filed first US spot Solana ETF in June 2024).

name: Grayscale Investments
current_role: World's largest digital currency asset manager; issuer of Grayscale Bitcoin Trust (GBTC), Bitcoin Mini Trust (BTC), Ethereum Trust (ETHE), and institutional single-asset/basket trusts
org: Grayscale Investments, LLC (subsidiary of Digital Currency Group)
notes: LEADERSHIP TRANSITION: Peter Mintzberg officially assumed the role of CEO in August 2024, succeeding Michael Sonnenshein. Grayscale's landmark August 2023 legal victory against the SEC in the DC Circuit Court compelled the SEC to approve all spot Bitcoin ETFs.

name: MicroStrategy (Strategy)
current_role: World's largest corporate holder of Bitcoin (>400,000+ BTC); operating as a Bitcoin Treasury Company using debt/equity capital markets alongside enterprise business analytics software
notes: BRAND UPDATE: Active corporate branding as Strategy (strategy.com). Key leadership: Michael Saylor (Co-founder & Executive Chairman, @saylor), Phong Le (President & CEO since August 2022). Regular Form 8-K purchase disclosures serve as major crypto market price catalysts.

name: Tesla
current_role: Electric vehicle and clean energy multinational holding substantial Bitcoin reserves (~9,720+ BTC) on balance sheet; accepts Dogecoin for selected merchandise
notes: CEO Elon Musk (@elonmusk) holds massive personal social influence over crypto market sentiment. Tesla's quarterly earnings balance sheet releases and on-chain wallet transactions (tracked by Arkham) are scrutinized by algorithmic trading desks.

name: JPMorgan Chase (Kinexys by J.P. Morgan / Onyx)
current_role: Largest US bank; operator of enterprise permissioned blockchain platform Kinexys (formerly Onyx), Kinexys Digital Payments (formerly JPM Coin System), and tokenized collateral networks
notes: MAJOR REBRAND: In November 2024, J.P. Morgan rebranded 'Onyx by J.P. Morgan' to 'Kinexys by J.P. Morgan', renaming JPM Coin System to Kinexys Digital Payments and launching on-chain FX. Key leadership: Umar Farooq (Co-head of J.P. Morgan Payments). Historical transaction volume exceeded $1.5T.

name: Standard Chartered (Zodia Custody & Zodia Markets)
current_role: Global systemically important bank offering institutional digital asset custody (Zodia Custody), OTC brokerage (Zodia Markets) via SC Ventures, and operating a bank spot crypto trading desk in London
notes: One of the most aggressive Tier-1 global banks in digital assets. Zodia Custody is backed by Standard Chartered, Northern Trust, and SBI Holdings. Head of Crypto Research Geoff Kendrick publishes influential macro price research models for BTC and ETH.

name: BNY (The Bank of New York Mellon)
current_role: World's largest custodian bank (~$50T AUC); provider of institutional digital asset custody in the US and Europe under MiCA; fund administrator for major spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs
org: The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation
notes: MASTER BRAND REBRAND: Rebranded corporate name to BNY in June 2024. In late 2024/2026, expanded digital asset custody to institutional clients in Europe under MiCA via BNY Mellon SA/NV. Serves as fund accountant and administrator for multiple US spot Bitcoin ETFs.

name: Jump Crypto
current_role: Algorithmic cryptocurrency market maker and Web3 builder division of Jump Trading Group; lead developer of Firedancer high-performance independent Solana validator client
notes: LEADERSHIP UPDATE: Former President Kanav Kariya (@KanavKariya) stepped down in June 2024 amid CFTC scrutiny. Key project: Firedancer (ground-up C++ validator client for Solana intended to eliminate single-client failure risk).

name: Wintermute
current_role: Global algorithmic crypto market maker and liquidity provider across major centralized exchanges, decentralized protocols (Bebop), and OTC trading desks; web3 venture investor
notes: Key leadership: Evgeny Gaevoy (Founder & CEO, @EvgenyGaevoy). Wintermute's labeled hot wallet addresses represent among the highest daily transactional volume in DeFi, actively monitored by Arkham, Lookonchain, and Nansen.

name: DWF Labs
current_role: High-frequency cryptocurrency market maker and multi-stage Web3 investment firm active in spot/derivatives liquidity provision, token warrants, and exchange listing liquidity
notes: Key leadership: Andrei Grachev (Managing Partner, @ag_dwf). DWF Labs wallet interactions and transfers frequently trigger speculative volatility on altcoin pairs; closely watched by on-chain tracking bots.

name: Coinbase Custody
current_role: NYSDFS-regulated limited-purpose trust company safeguarding digital assets for institutional clients and serving as primary custodian for over 80% of US spot Bitcoin & Ethereum ETFs
org: Coinbase Custody Trust Company, LLC (subsidiary of Coinbase Global, Inc.)
notes: Extreme market concentration: Custodian for BlackRock (IBIT), Grayscale (GBTC/BTC), Bitwise (BITB), Ark 21Shares (ARKB), Invesco Galaxy (BTCO), Franklin Templeton (EZBC), and Valkyrie (BRRR). Key leadership: Brian Armstrong (CEO, @brian_armstrong), Alesia Haas (CFO).

name: BitGo
current_role: Institutional digital asset custodian, multi-sig security developer, and regulated trust company; primary custodian for Wrapped Bitcoin (WBTC) and Hashdex Bitcoin ETF
org: BitGo Holdings, Inc. / BitGo Trust Company, Inc.
notes: Key leadership: Mike Belshe (Co-founder & CEO, @MikeBelshe). BitGo's August 2024 announcement shifting WBTC custody to a joint venture with BiT Global sparked intense DeFi governance discussions regarding collateral risk management across MakerDAO/Sky and Aave.

name: Fireblocks
current_role: Enterprise digital asset MPC custody infrastructure provider; secures digital asset transactions, treasury, and tokenization rails for over 2,000 financial institutions and web3 platforms
notes: Key leadership: Michael Shaulov (Co-founder & CEO, @mshaulov), Idan Ofrat (Co-founder & CPO). Provides the core Multi-Party Computation (MPC) infrastructure powering institutional custody for BNY, Zodia Custody, Revolut, and BNP Paribas.

name: Anchorage Digital
current_role: First federally chartered crypto bank in the United States (Anchorage Digital Bank National Association); provides OCC-regulated qualified custody, staking, settlement, and prime brokerage
notes: Holds a National Bank Charter from the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC). Serves as custodian for 21Shares Core Ethereum ETF (CETH) and institutional client collateral. Key leadership: Nathan McCauley (Co-founder & CEO, @mccauley), Diogo Mónica (Co-founder & President, @diogomonica).

name: Whale Alert
current_role: Large blockchain transaction & whale tracking service
notes: Telegram 和 X 上存在大量仿冒 @whale_alert 的钓鱼与骗局账号，仅信任通过官方网站校验的唯一蓝色认证推特账号。

api_access.free_tier: 无永久免费 API Key，提供入门开发者版 7 天免费试用；官方推特 @whale_alert 及 Telegram 公开频道提供大额转账实时广播
api_access.commercial_terms: 个人开发者版（Alerts API）$29.95/月仅限个人非商业用途；企业版（Enterprise API）$699/月及 Enterprise Big Data（定制报价）允许商业化集成与高频数据订阅
api_access.rate_limits: 个人版最高 100 alerts/小时；企业版 500 requests/分钟且最高 10,000 alerts/小时；Big Data 版 1,000+ requests/分钟
api_access.attribution_required: 强制要求。商业与公开引用大额报警数据或链上归属推断数据时必须注明 Whale Alert

name: Arkham Intelligence
notes: 实体优先（Entity-First）链上情报领头羊，精准监控美国/德国/英国政府查扣比特币地址、贝莱德等 ETF 托管地址及主流交易所冷钱包。CEO 为 Miguel Morel。
